people.name: Abiezer
people.line: Clan of Manasseh, home of Gideon

people.name: Gideon
people.line: Judge of Israel; defeated Midianites; tested and reassured by God.

translations.web: But Yahweh’s Spirit came on Gideon, and he blew a trumpet; and Abiezer was gathered together to follow him.
translations.bsb: So the Spirit of the LORD came upon Gideon, who blew the ram’s horn and rallied the Abiezrites behind him.
